metadata.title: When you click like a confused squirrel and somehow get 2 kills? Valorant, explain!
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was swatting flies.
Enemy probably uninstalling mid-round.
Valorant logic is broken but I’ll take it!
Click if your aim’s just guessing too!

Tap if your best kills come from pure accident!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
